variants.name: 01-marcador-arcade
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-quality art-directed game UI proposal board, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 or higher. Input image is REFERENCE for existing approved game world, characters, kitchen equipment and pixel art style. It is NOT a website redesign. Preserve the reference pixel-art diner, female customer in red varsity jacket and cap, stainless worktop, red tiles, five ingredient bins and the three burner grill, sauces. Crisp pixel art, restrained Endesga64-like colors, square stepped outlines, sharp pixel lettering, no vector cartoon, no 3D, no blurred edges, no photorealism, no glass UI. Board background warm very dark charcoal. Large clear Spanish title at top. Main large landscape gameplay screenshot about 72% of board width plus a narrower mobile layout on right; bottom strip contains enlarged detail crops of cooking indicators and recipe progression, with minimal Spanish labels. The UI is the focus and must be large and legible. Within game, 3 hearts, Clientes 08, Récord 24, pause symbol must be together in ONE centered cohesive panel. No duplicate lives/counters/pause elsewhere. No money, no coins, no extra game mechanics, no timer for whole session. Customer patience has distinct clock icon + 18 s, NEVER heart icons (hearts only lives). Cooking indicators must distinguish 3 simultaneously cooking patties: one still cooking, one ready, one about to burn; show clear association to their respective burners; do not cover the patties or ingredient bins. Recipe refers to Clásica, show ordered steps from base bun to meat to cheese to lettuce to tomato to catsup to top bun. Progress in natural reading order; use icons plus names and checkmarks, currently next ingredient cheese. Preserve camera and main relative positions of environment and customer. This is a conceptual design board, not an implemented screenshot. Do not include explanatory paragraphs, annotation arrows, watermark or mock device hardware.
Title verbatim: "01 / MARCADOR ARCADE". Direction A: one compact centered dark burgundy diner arcade scoreboard at top center with a cream pixel border; single row contains three hearts, separator, "CLIENTES 08", "RÉCORD 24", square pause button. Keep this panel moderate width, do not span whole game. Under it customer face remains unobscured. To LEFT of customer replace giant old blank receipt with a SHORT cream paper order clipped to rail; heading "CLÁSICA · 2/7"; small customer clock "18 s" integrated into receipt header. Vertical compact list read TOP TO BOTTOM: checked Pan base, checked Carne, highlighted next "Queso", Lechuga, Tomate, Cátsup, Pan tapa. Paper height fits exactly 7 rows with no giant blank gap. No crossed-out pale tiny labels. Cook indicators replace linear bars with stepped semicircular dials immediately ABOVE each of three patties, numbered tiny 1 2 3 and captions "3 s", checkmark "LISTA", exclamation "RETIRA"; empty center transparent to see meat. Green ready, yellow cooking, red near burning with symbols redundant to color. Show enlarged dial details at bottom with labels "COCINANDO", "LISTA", "RETIRA". Mobile version keeps top centered scoreboard in two compact rows, same short receipt beside customer not over face. Professional, readable restrained arcade aesthetic.

Title verbatim: "02 / CONSOLA DE MOSTRADOR". Direction B is materially DIFFERENT from A: integrate all global HUD into one centered small dark enamel console inset into the FRONT FACE of the stainless customer worktop, directly below the served burger and ABOVE the ingredient bins. The front worktop fascia gets a little added height to fit this, do NOT overlay ingredient bins. Console single row shows three hearts | "08 CLIENTES" | trophy "24" | square pause button. No global HUD at screen top; let diner ceiling breathe. A compact cream speech-bubble recipe panel to left of customer tied by a small tail: header "CLÁSICA" and customer clock "18 s"; then a HORIZONTAL sequence of ingredient mini tiles in two rows, connected by tiny chevrons, readable left-to-right, top-to-bottom: Pan base check, Carne check, Queso highlighted, Lechuga, Tomate, Cátsup, Pan tapa. Footer "SIGUE: QUESO". No tall paper ticket. Cooking: integrate three miniature segmented heat gauges into a dedicated front metal strip OF THE GRILL, one below each burner, square numbered tags 1 2 3 matching burner marks. Each has a six-block progress path plus clear status caption "3 s", "LISTA", "¡SACA!". Preserve visibility of meat, no thin gradient bars. Customer clock in speech bubble, distinct from cooking. Bottom enlarged detail shows square stepped heat blocks and recipe tiles. Mobile adapts centered fascia console into two rows, recipe bubble above and left of customer. Restrained cream/steel/burgundy materiality matching environment.

Title verbatim: "03 / PANEL CENTRAL DE TURNO". Direction C clearly different: one centered wide cream diner order board HANGING FROM CEILING just at upper center, with burgundy frame, occupying upper 24% of game. Two structured rows within same unified board: TOP row contains three hearts, "CLIENTES 08", "RÉCORD 24", pause square; SECOND row contains "CLÁSICA · 2/7", clock "18 s", next-action highlighted "SIGUE: QUESO". THIRD short row shows seven ingredient pictograms in left-to-right order with names in tiny pixel text and checks on first two; current cheese outlined. This board unifies globals, order and customer timing into one central location; no left receipt and no separate patience bar over head. Customer head starts just below the board; use extra vertical game space if needed, don't shrink customer unreasonably or obscure face. Cook indicators minimal: each patty has a small squared status pennant directly ABOVE its own burner, hanging labels "1 · 3 s", "2 · LISTA ✓", "3 · ¡RETIRA!" with a small chunky five-step dot countdown under cooking and danger labels; no arcs, no long bars, no gradient tracks. Burger stays center on counter. Enlarged detail strip shows these three flags and ingredient sequence. On mobile the central cream board at top becomes three compact stacked rows, preserving same groups and clock; customer below; no side receipt so scene feels open. Strong spatial hierarchy, restrained visual density.
